verdict.rationale: The docs show automatic tracing for supported LLM provider integrations, naming OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere and Mistral, with token and cost capture that needs no extra code. They also describe tracing agents built with "popular SDKs and harnesses" through an OTel-compatible SDK and OTLP endpoint. Framework-level integrations are not named, so LangChain and Vercel AI SDK support can only be inferred from the generic OTel path or manual `weave.op` wrapping. missing for 10: explicit LangChain integration, explicit Vercel AI SDK integration, a documented list of framework integrations, independent hands-on corroboration.
